# Descriptions
@@ 1
This spell is used to bond junior officers or troops to a superior officer (to
allow the Enlisted target to be the target of higher level spells on this
list). The caster may only have as many Enlisted troops at any given time as
he has levels, but he may discharge an Enlisted soldier at any time. Otherwise
the Enlistment lasts until the caster or the target is dead. The process takes
1 minute per level of the target.
@@ 2
Caster learns the exact number of viewed troops and their general type (e.g.,
60% infantry, 20% cavalry, 20% archers). Typing is based on visible equipment
(and may not be entirely accurate).
@@ 3
For the duration of this spell, the caster receives a special +25 bonus to all
Signaling maneuvers. Spell does not provide the means (flags, trumpets, smoke
signals etc).
@@ 4
The casting of this spell grants the caster a special bonus of +25 to his next
History (Battles) maneuver (which must be made within one minute of casting
this spell).
@@ 5
The caster can mentally send one command (maximum of one word per level of the
caster) to a single Enlisted target (within range of this spell). The target
is under no compulsion to follow the command, but will know who is the sender
of the message. Communication is strictly one way.
@@ 6
The casting of this spell grants the caster a special bonus of +50 to his next
Military Organization maneuver (which must be made within one minute of
casting this spell).
@@ 7
The caster is aware of the location of all living Enlisted targets within the
area of effect for the duration of this spell.
@@ 8
The casting of this spell grants the caster a special bonus of +50 to his next
Siege Engineering maneuver (which must be made within one minute of casting
this spell).
@@ 9
The casting of this spell grants the caster a special bonus of +50 to his next
Tactics maneuver (which must be made within one minute of casting this spell).
@@ 10
The casting of this spell grants the caster a special bonus of +50 to his next
Leadership maneuver (which must be made within one minute of casting this
spell).
@@ 11
As Mental Command, except the caster can mentally send a set of commands. The
set of commands is limited to a maximum of one sentence per level of the
caster.
@@ 12
For the duration of the spell, the caster’s voice is amplified so that it can
be heard over the din of battle in the given area. This spell confers no
command ability but merely allows the caster to be heard.
@@ 13
As Mental Command, except any or all Enlisted targets can receive the command.
@@ 14
The casting of this spell grants the caster a special bonus of +75 to all
Situational Awareness (Combat) maneuvers made during the duration of this
spell.
@@ 15
Any or all Enlisted targets of the caster can be compelled to follow a command
of the caster (maximum of one word per level of the caster) which is not
totally alien to the targets, (i.e., no suicide suggestion, but extremely
dangerous orders “Charge and attack the enemy archers on the hill” can be
given). Note that the targets must be able to hear the command of the caster.
@@ 16
Caster may mentally communicate with a single Enlisted target within range
while both concentrate. The target will be aware of who is attempting to
communicate. Communication is two-way, with neither party being under any
compulsion to obey the other.
@@ 17
When cast on Enlisted troops, this provides the targets with a special bonus
of +50 to all RRs versus fear and charm attacks (and provides them with
unshakable morale for the duration of this spell). This will rally even
previously routed troops. This spell does not protect the targets against
Order or Mission spells.
@@ 18
As Mental Orders, except any or all Enlisted targets can receive the orders.
@@ 19
When cast on Enlisted troops, this will make the caster aware of the
individual Enlisted troops’ views on a given issue.
@@ 20
As Battle Awareness I, except the caster is also aware of the general health
status (unwounded, lightly or seriously wounded, unconscious, dying) of each
Enlisted target for the duration of the spell.
@@ 25
As Battle Communication, except the caster may simultaneously mentally contact
up to 1 Enlisted target per five levels of the caster (within range of this
spell). Once established, communication is effectively a mental conference
with all targets able to send and receive.
@@ 30
Any or all Enlisted targets of the caster will receive a bonus equal to the
level of the caster to all melee attacks, missile attacks and moving maneuvers
for the duration of this spell. The caster must be alive and visible for the
benefits to be received, and the caster himself does not receive these
benefits.
@@ 50
As Order, except the caster can give a set of commands (maximum of one
sentence per level of the caster) to the Enlisted targets. (This can include
“suicide missions”-“ Defend this position against the enemy until you have
killed all the members of the enemy forces”).
